description: Node repos on pnpm: deduped lockfiles, and the rules for breaking updates of the group's own packages

packageRules.description: Merged on their own once the checks are green: dev dependencies (minor and patch) and patches of anything but the organization's own packages. Majors and @velumbra/* stay for review.

A new major of a module this one needs: its range moves to the new major only, which drops the old one for the app, so it is this module's major too (feat!). Keeping both instead (^1 || ^2) is a minor: edit the range and drop the `!`.
Below 1.0 a minor is breaking (semver: ^0.3 takes no 0.4), so a new minor of a module this one needs is breaking for it too, released below 1.0 as its own minor.
